newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Reflex closes two of three internet cafes.
newsitem.headline: Reflex closes two of three internet cafes.

text.p: Reflex Group Plc said on Thursday that it had closed two out of the three UK-based internet cafes which make up its subsidiary Hands On Ltd.
A full provision for the termination of these activities will be made in the group's interim statement for the six months to June 30, 1997 due to be published in August, Reflex said in a statement.
Hands On Ltd commenced operations in the last quarter of 1996 when the three cafes were opened.
The remaining companies in the group are engaged in computer hardware rental and are trading profitably, Reflex said.
